subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can name the features of a good interview.
I can write questions with different question words.
I can check my interview for capital letters and question marks.

tf.s: A good interview uses lots of different question words.
tf.why: Yes! What, when, where, who, how and why.

tf.s: Hashim's biggest model is a model of a ship.
tf.why: Correct! It is nearly one metre long.

tf.s: Questions about "the best" or "the biggest" make interviews boring.
tf.why: They make the answers more interesting.

tf.s: Every question needs a question mark at the end.
"what do you like swimming?" is a correct question.
tf.why: It should be "Why do you like swimming?" with a capital letter.

tf.s: "Who helps you?" can have the answer "Sometimes my dad."
tf.why: Yes! Who asks about a person.

tf.s: We use "Where" to ask about time.
tf.why: Where asks about places; When asks about time.

tf.s: An interview has questions and answers.
A question starts with a small letter.
tf.why: Questions start with a capital letter.

tf.s: "When did you start this hobby?" can have the answer "When I was six."

boxes.q: ___ did you start this hobby? – When I was six.
___ do you play? – In the park.
___ do you like swimming? – Because it's fun.
A good interview has lots of different ___.
boxes.why: Different question words make a good interview.

boxes.q: How long is Hashim's ship model?
In an interview, who asks the questions?
"I play every Saturday." Which question fits?
Which word asks about a way of doing something?

mcq.why: Hashim's interview is about making models.

mcq.q: Which list has only question words?
o: what, when, where, who, how, why
what, and, but, who, how, why
the, best, most, big, how, why
is, are, do, does, can, could

mcq.q: What are two features of a good interview?
o: lots of question words and questions about the best or biggest
no question marks and short answers
mcq.why: Variety and interesting questions make a good interview.

mcq.q: What is the structure of an interview?
mcq.why: An interview has an introduction, questions and answers.

mcq.q: Which question with Why is good for an interview about swimming?
mcq.why: Capital letter, correct form and a question mark.

o: What is the best match you've played?
mcq.why: It asks about the best thing.
Capital letter at the start, question mark at the end.

mcq.q: Why is "What's the best model you've made?" a good question?
o: It asks about the best thing, so the answer is interesting.
mcq.why: Questions about the best give interesting answers.

mcq.q: Which question is the most interesting for Hashim?
o: What is the most difficult model you have made?
mcq.why: It invites a long, interesting answer.

mcq.q: "Sometimes my dad." Which question gives this answer?
mcq.why: The answer is a person, so the question uses Who.
